areas.narrativeSummary: The school states that its vision and values aim to help children respond in a kind and fair way to everyone, regardless of age, ability, gender, skin colour, nationality, beliefs, language, culture or family background [1]. Its curriculum is described as building essential knowledge and skills on the values of Love, Hope and Community [3], while religious education revisits the 'Golden Threads' of Love, Belonging, Special and Community through Living Difference IV [4]. Geography teaching is also linked to pupils' spiritual, moral, social and cultural development and their understanding of their place in the world and responsibilities to others and the environment [2].
